name: Wholesale Engine – Wholesale Prices, B2B & Dynamic Pricing for WooCommerce
author: pluginshift

sections.description:
Wholesale Engine is a WooCommerce wholesale and B2B plugin for selling to businesses, retail customers or both from one store. Give each wholesale role its own prices, build dynamic pricing and discount rules, approve wholesale customers through a registration form and control who can see prices and buy.

Everything marked Free below works without a licence, has no usage limits and never expires. Wholesale Engine Pro is a separate paid add-on for the full B2B ordering workflow.

Website | Features | Documentation | Support | Pricing

Wholesale Prices and Role Based Pricing — Free

Set wholesale prices for each customer group without changing what retail customers pay. Wholesale customers see their price automatically as soon as they log in.

  • Role baseline discount: A percentage off the whole catalog for every member of a role.
  • Product discount rules: Percentage off, amount off or a fixed wholesale price.
  • Targets: Everyone, logged-in customers, guests, chosen wholesale roles or individual customers.
  • Products: All products, selected products or variations, categories, tags or brands, with exclusions.
  • Discount base: Calculate from the regular price or the sale price; a wholesale price never goes above a running sale price.
  • Price display: Price suffixes such as “excl. VAT”, and wholesale prices shown as a range, minimum or maximum on shop pages.

Schedule any rule with a start and end date, limit how many times it can be used, and import or export rules as CSV.

Tiered Pricing and Dynamic Discount Rules — Free

One rules engine for every dynamic pricing offer. Prices are calculated once per request, so wholesale, sale and tiered prices never double-discount.

  • Volume pricing tiers: “Buy more, save more” quantity pricing with a tier table on the product page.
  • Cart discount: Based on cart subtotal, total quantity or total weight.
  • Buy X Get Y: Free or discounted reward products.
  • Surcharge / extra fee: Optionally taxable, optionally only for chosen payment methods.
  • Minimum and maximum purchase quantity: Per product line or for the whole cart, with quantity steps (e.g. packs of 6).
  • Checkout gate: Decide who is allowed to place an order.

Wholesale User Roles — Free

Create unlimited wholesale customer roles such as Distributor, Retailer, Reseller or VIP. For each role:

  • Set a baseline wholesale discount.
  • Show prices including or excluding tax, or make the role tax exempt.
  • Allow or block coupons.
  • Move customers into the role automatically after a qualifying order.

Wholesale Registration Form and Approvals — Free

Build a B2B registration form with a drag-and-drop builder and live preview.

  • Business fields: company name, VAT number, tax ID, reseller number, business type, phone, website and file upload.
  • Text, number, select, multi-select, radio, checkbox and section fields, with conditional logic.
  • Layouts: registration only, login + registration side by side, tabbed or popup.
  • Let applicants choose their wholesale role, or assign one automatically.
  • Approve manually, automatically or after email verification. Pending and rejected applicants see their status when they try to log in.
  • Typography, colour and button controls for both forms, no custom CSS needed.
  • Spam protection with Google reCAPTCHA v2 / v3 and a honeypot.
  • Add the forms with the registration and login blocks or shortcodes.

Private Store, Catalog Mode and Hidden Prices — Free

Run a wholesale-only private store, a retail store or a hybrid B2B + B2C store.

  • Store mode: B2B (wholesale only), B2C (public only) or hybrid.
  • Login to view price: Guests see your message and a login link instead of the price and the Add to cart button.
  • Catalog mode: Make products non-purchasable across the store.
  • Hidden price / price on request: Per product, category or customer group.
  • Product access control: Hide chosen products from chosen customers, including their direct links.
  • Hide stock: Hide stock completely, or only the quantity, from retail customers.
  • Private store: Send logged-out visitors to the login page, with a list of URLs that stay public.

Hidden prices and blocked products stay hidden in the product page, cart, block checkout, the WooCommerce Store API and structured data.

Tax / VAT Exemption — Free

Exempt wholesale customers from tax per role, or with a tax rule limited to chosen countries. You can also apply a specific tax class to a customer group.

Wholesale Orders and B2B Analytics — Free

  • B2B dashboard: Net revenue, orders, items sold, average order value, customers and order status for wholesale orders, with date ranges and CSV export.
  • WooCommerce Orders: A “Wholesale Engine” column and a Wholesale / Retail filter make wholesale orders easy to find.

Emails — Free

Customisable emails for registration received (admin), pending, approved, rejected, email verification and email verified, edited in a built-in designer with smart tags such as {customer_name}.

Wholesale Engine Pro (Separate Paid Add-on)

Wholesale Engine Pro needs the free plugin and adds the full B2B ordering workflow:

  • Bulk Order Form: Add many products to the cart in one pass, with product and SKU search.
  • Purchase Lists: Saved product lists customers re-order in one click.
  • Sub Accounts: Team members with their own logins, permissions and spending limits.
  • Request a Quote: Add-to-quote flow and a storefront quote button.
  • Deal Room: Buyer ↔ store negotiation with custom offers that apply at checkout.
  • Store Credit Wallet: Top-ups and wallet payments, including the block checkout.
  • Payment and shipping method rules: Allow or block payment gateways and shipping methods per customer group.

Compare Free and Pro. Free features keep working if Pro is deactivated.

Compatibility

  • WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • WooCommerce Cart and Checkout blocks, and the classic cart and checkout.
  • Simple and variable products.
  • Any theme: changes run through WooCommerce hooks, theme files are never modified.
  • Translation ready (text domain wholesale-engine). Translate Wholesale Engine.
  • WP-CLI commands to export and import pricing rules.

Documentation and Support

  • Documentation: installation and setup guides.
  • Support: help from the Wholesale Engine team.
  • Free support forum on WordPress.org.

Developed by PluginShift.

External services

PluginShift usage data (opt-in)

The Quick Setup wizard asks whether you want to share basic site details with PluginShift to help improve the plugin. Nothing is sent unless an administrator clicks “Allow & Continue”. The data is then sent once to https://api.pluginshift.com/api/v1/quick-setup: site URL, admin email (which may be used to send you Wholesale Engine news and offers), plugin, WordPress, PHP and database versions, web server, active theme and plugins (names and versions), language, timezone, and multisite and debug flags. No customer, order, product, pricing or visitor data is sent.

PluginShift Privacy Policy | Data Collection Policy | Terms

Google reCAPTCHA

Off by default. When you enable reCAPTCHA and add your keys, Google’s reCAPTCHA script loads on the Wholesale Engine registration and login forms, and each submission is verified with https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api/siteverify (secret key, response token and the visitor’s IP address). Google may also collect browser and device information and set cookies. Mention reCAPTCHA in your store’s privacy policy.

Google Terms | Google Privacy
sections.installation:
Requirements

  • WordPress 6.4 or later.
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or later, installed and active.
  • PHP 7.4 or later.

Install from the WordPress dashboard

  1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New and search for “Wholesale Engine”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Follow the Quick Setup wizard, or open the Wholesale Engine menu to set up roles, pricing and settings.
  5. Log in as a wholesale customer to check the prices they see.

Upload the plugin ZIP

  1. Download the plugin ZIP from WordPress.org.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin and choose the ZIP.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Getting started

  1. Create one or more wholesale roles (e.g. Distributor, Retailer).
  2. Add pricing rules or a role baseline discount.
  3. Build your registration form and add it to a page.
  4. Choose your store mode (B2B, B2C or hybrid) under Settings.

See the documentation for step-by-step guides.
sections.faq:
Is the free version limited?

No. The features marked Free work without a licence, with no trial period, product limit or usage quota.

Can I run a B2B and B2C hybrid store?

Yes. Use the hybrid store mode: retail customers see normal prices and logged-in wholesale customers see their wholesale prices in the same store.

How do I set up role based pricing in WooCommerce?

Go to Wholesale Engine → User Roles, create a role (for example “Wholesale Customer”) and set its baseline discount. Assign the role to customers, or let them apply through the registration form. For product-, category- or quantity-specific prices, add a rule under Pricing Rules and target that role. Read the guide.

Can different roles have different wholesale prices?

Yes. Each role can have its own baseline discount, and every pricing rule can target one or more roles or individual customers.

Can I set tiered or quantity-based wholesale pricing?

Yes, in the free plugin. Add a Volume Pricing Tiers rule and a tier table is shown on the product page.

How do I hide prices until a customer logs in?

Turn on Login to view price under Settings → Price. For a fully closed wholesale store, use Private store or the B2B (Wholesale only) store mode. Read the guide.

How do I create a wholesale registration form?

Open Wholesale Engine → Registration, add the fields you need, choose an approval method and add the form to any page with its block or shortcode. Read the guide.

Can I set a minimum order quantity for wholesale customers?

Yes. Add a Minimum or Maximum Purchase Quantity rule for a role, product or category, per product line or for the whole cart. Read the guide.

Can wholesale customers be tax exempt?

Yes. Mark a role as tax exempt, or add a Tax Override rule that exempts chosen customers or applies a tax class. Read the guide.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes. Wholesale prices apply to every variation, including the price range shown on shop pages.

Does it work with the block Cart & Checkout and HPOS?

Yes. Wholesale prices, rules and restrictions work in the block and classic Cart and Checkout, and the plugin is compatible with High-Performance Order Storage.

How do I find my wholesale orders?

Go to WooCommerce → Orders. The Wholesale Engine column marks wholesale orders, and the Wholesale / Retail filter shows only the orders you need. Read the guide.

Which features need Wholesale Engine Pro?

The Bulk Order Form, Purchase Lists, Sub Accounts, Request a Quote, Deal Room, Store Credit Wallet and payment / shipping method rules. Everything else on this page is free. Compare Free and Pro.

Do I need the free plugin if I buy Pro?

Yes. Pro is an add-on: keep this free plugin installed and active. How to install Pro.

Does the plugin send any data?

Only if you agree in the Quick Setup wizard; nothing is sent if you click “Skip”. No customer, order, product, pricing or visitor data is ever sent. See External services above and the data & privacy guide.

Where can I get help?

Read the documentation, ask in the support forum or contact support.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0 – 21/10/2026

New

  • Added: “Wholesale Engine” column and a Wholesale / Retail orders filter on the WooCommerce Orders screen. “View all orders” on the dashboard opens the wholesale orders list.
  • Added: New Wholesale Engine brand icon.

Security

  • Fixed: Shop Managers could reject or block administrator accounts through the users and registration endpoints.
  • Fixed: “Login to view price”, private store and hidden products could still be bought or priced through direct add-to-cart links, the Store API and product structured data (JSON-LD).
  • Fixed: CSV exports now neutralise spreadsheet formulas in customer-entered names.
  • Fixed: An email verification link could override an administrator’s decision to reject an applicant.

Pricing & taxes

  • Fixed: Tax exemption (a role’s “Tax exempt” setting and tax exemption rules) did not remove tax at checkout.
  • Fixed: Wholesale buyers could pay more than the running sale price; scheduled sales are now respected.
  • Fixed: Cart conditions (subtotal, quantity, weight), product filters and cart-wide maximum quantities in pricing rules.
  • Fixed: Two cart rules with the same fee label only applied once.
  • Fixed: Rule usage limits were counted for orders that did not contain the rule’s products.
  • Fixed: Variable product price ranges could show stale or another visitor’s prices.
  • Fixed: Roles set to Inactive still applied their discounts and restrictions.
  • Fixed: Wholesale prices could be lost when cart totals were recalculated.
  • Fixed: Saving one field of a pricing rule no longer resets its other fields.
  • Fixed: A coupon applied as a guest stayed active after logging in to a role with coupons disabled.

Registration & emails

  • Fixed: Required file upload fields could never be submitted.
  • Fixed: Conditional fields based on radio buttons or multi-selects did not show or validate.
  • Fixed: The registration popup was open on page load and blocked the page.
  • Fixed: reCAPTCHA v3 always failed.
  • Fixed: Smart tags such as {customer_name} were not replaced in sent emails.
  • Fixed: Pending, rejected and unverified applicants now see their account status when logging in.
  • Fixed: The [wsleng_login] form was unstyled.
  • Fixed: Pro shortcodes no longer print as raw text on stores without Pro.

Improvements

  • Improved: Admin interface polish — select menus, registration builder layout, dashboard cards, current-section highlighting and mobile layouts.
  • Improved: Feature screens apply immediately — newly enabled My Account pages no longer need a permalink save.
  • Improved: Uninstalling with “Enable deletion of plugin data” now removes all plugin data.
  • Fixed: The documented WP-CLI commands export-rules and import-rules.
  • Fixed: B2B analytics included retail orders on stores without HPOS.
  • Fixed: The Settings screen could freeze, and the role editor kept the previous role’s values when adding a new role.

1.0.2 – 29/07/2026

  • Added: Store credit Wallet Features

1.0.1 – 03/07/2026

  • Added: Minimum Purchase Quantity Price Rule

1.0.0 – 30/06/2026

  • Initial release of Wholesale Engine — the all-in-one B2B & wholesale plugin for WooCommerce.
  • Wholesale user roles with automatic, role-based pricing.
  • Dynamic pricing & discount rules: product, role, quantity/tiered, cart, payment, shipping and tax rules, plus min/max order quantity, hidden price and non-purchasable products.
  • Tiered “buy more, save more” pricing table on product pages.
  • Catalog mode, login to view price, hide stock, hide products and private store with URL whitelist.
  • Store modes: B2B, B2C and hybrid B2B + B2C.
  • Drag-and-drop wholesale registration form builder with layout templates, customer types, approval workflow, reCAPTCHA, and full design controls.
  • Request a Quote with a built-in Deal Room for offers and negotiation.
  • Bulk order form and savable purchase lists.
  • Sub-accounts with per-member permissions.
  • Store credit wallet payment method.
  • Customisable transactional emails and a central feature-control screen.
